rows.question: As penal interest is mandatory under RBI rules, at what rate should we add it to the loan rate?
rows.answer: For this Primary (Urban) Co-operative Bank case, penal interest is not permitted to be added to the rate of interest charged on the advances, so there is no rate to add. The applicable direction says the penalty for non-compliance of material loan terms shall be treated as penal charges and shall not be levied as penal interest added to the loan rate. The question’s assumption that penal interest is mandatory is not supported for this bank because the in-force direction says it is not permitted.
